items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: That's how I come to play behind Bessie Smith, Ida Cox, Sarah Martin, Ma Rainey, and all the old-time Blues singers.

ctx.x: But then we got into the Frolie Theatre. That's how I come to play behind Bessie Smith, Ida Cox, Sarah Martin, Ma Rainey, and all the old-time Blues singers. Butterbeans and Suzie. Ashes(?)...
